item_62_compile_probe.fixture:
#include <stdbool.h>
#define likely(x) (x)
struct request_queue {int enabled;};struct cfq_data {struct request_queue *queue;};
#ifdef TRACE_ON
static inline bool blk_trace_note_message_enabled(struct request_queue *q){return q->enabled;}
#else
#define blk_trace_note_message_enabled(q) (false)
#endif
#define blk_add_cgroup_trace_msg(...) do {} while(0)
#define cfq_log_cfqq(cfqd, cfqq, fmt, args...)	do {			\
	if (likely(!blk_trace_note_message_enabled((bfqd)->queue)))	\
		break;							\
	blk_add_cgroup_trace_msg((cfqd)->queue,				\
			cfqg_to_blkg((cfqq)->cfqg)->blkcg,		\
			"cfq%d%c%c " fmt, (cfqq)->pid,			\
			cfq_cfqq_sync((cfqq)) ? 'S' : 'A',		\
			cfqq_type((cfqq)) == SYNC_NOIDLE_WORKLOAD ? 'N' : ' ',\
			  ##args);					\
} while (0)

#define cfq_log_cfqg(cfqd, cfqg, fmt, args...)	do {			\
	if (likely(!blk_trace_note_message_enabled((bfqd)->queue)))	\
		break;							\
	blk_add_cgroup_trace_msg((cfqd)->queue,				\
			cfqg_to_blkg(cfqg)->blkcg, fmt, ##args);	\
} while (0)


int main(void){struct request_queue q={0};struct cfq_data obj={&q};struct cfq_data *cfqd=&obj;(void)cfqd;cfq_log_cfqq(cfqd,0,"x");cfq_log_cfqg(cfqd,0,"x");return 0;}
item_62_compile_probe.conclusion: trace-off compiles because helper macro discards argument; trace-on fails undeclared bfqd; correcting only typo compiles in this bounded fixture
